Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

EASY MEALS FOR 2 EP 22 Crispy Gochujang Chicken Thighs Ingredients Really a meal for 1 because someone ate all of it :)  Chicken * 400–450 g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1/2 teaspoon salt * 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder * 1/2 teaspoon black pepper * 3 tablespoons cornstarch * 3–4 tablespoons neutral oil, for shallow-frying, enough to cover bottom of pan  Spicy gochujang sauce * 1 tbsp butter  * 1½ tablespoons gochujang * 1 tablespoon soy sauce * 1 tablespoon brown sugar * 1 tablespoon rice vinegar * 2 teaspoons sesame oil * 3 cloves garlic, finely minced * 1 teaspoon grated ginger * 1/4 cup water For serving * Steamed rice * Sliced green onion * Toasted sesame seeds * Cucumber, optional Instructions 1. Pat the chicken thighs dry and cut them into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt, garlic powder, black pepper. 2. Add the cornstarch and toss until the chicken is evenly coated with a thin, dry layer. 3. Heat the neutral oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and shallow-fry for 4–5 minutes per side, or until golden, crispy and cooked through. Work in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Carefully remove the oil, add butter to skillet. 5. Reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for about 30 seconds. 6. Stir in the gochujang, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, water and optional gochugaru. Simmer for 1–2 minutes, stirring, until glossy and slightly thickened. 7. Return the chicken to the skillet and toss for 30–60 seconds, until evenly coated. Don’t cook it in the sauce for too long or the coating will soften. 8. Serve immediately over rice and finish with green onion and sesame seeds. #chicken #koreanchicken #cooking #EasyRecipe #creatorsearchinsights
